groups.qk: Q and K projections, QK gains and head scales

limits: Measured on RTX A6000 and A100; the runs trained on H100, B200 and B300.
The blocked reference kernels stand in for the Mosaic and fused kernels the runs trained on.
One checkpoint per run and four sequences; the raw gradient, before clipping and the optimizer.
Evaluations whose forwards differ in the last FP32 bit differ by the BF16 model's rounding noise (stable_vs_fp64_head); where forward_shared is false the production comparisons carry it.
A gradient error is not a perplexity cost.

runs.description: exp with fixed ALiBi decay, no RoPE
runs.label: exp-alibi-fixed-no-rope

scope: The gradient of the mean next-token NLL at run checkpoints, on GPU, with five head RMSNorms selected in one compiled program: each run's own source ('production'), a stable FP32 evaluation, a host FP64 one, and production's forward with the stable or the host FP64 backward; the whole model in FP64 on the first sequence; and the VJP of every committed head RMSNorm on synthetic FP32 rows against FP64. Each run keeps its recipe and precision with attention_backend blocked, on the first four held-out sequences of its eval manifest, one sequence per evaluation. Relative differences are ||left - right|| / ||right||.
